I'm Ankur — an independent LLM researcher working on LLM pretraining, reinforcement
learning, and shrinking the KV cache. What follows are writeups of my experiments,
grouped by the codebase they came out of. Previously at Microsoft and AWS.

[GitHub](https://github.com/clankur){.btn .btn-outline-primary .btn-sm}

---

## [seqax](https://clankur.github.io/seqax/)

Pretraining experiments in [seqax](https://github.com/clankur/seqax), a small LLM
pretraining codebase in JAX.

| Report | Summary |
|--------|---------|
| [Shared KV](https://clankur.github.io/seqax/shared_kv.html) | Tying keys and values in multi-head attention — tested at 270M and 1B on C4 |
| [Position Embeddings](https://clankur.github.io/seqax/position_embeddings.html) | CoPE vs ALiBi vs RoPE at 31M scale |
| [Power Scheduler](https://clankur.github.io/seqax/power_scheduler.html) | 95-run HPO sweep of the power-law LR schedule vs cosine at 37M |
| [LCM](https://clankur.github.io/seqax/lcm.html) | Jointly-trained Large Concept Model for KV cache compression at 31M |

## [rooner](https://clankur.github.io/rooner/)

| Report | Summary |
|--------|---------|
| [LLMs yearn for the mines](https://clankur.github.io/rooner/exp161.html) | Mode collapse in one gradient step |

## [doomer](https://clankur.github.io/doomer/)

RL experiments in [doomer](https://github.com/clankur/doomer), a PyTorch RL training
codebase using ViZDoom.

| Report | Summary |
|--------|---------|
| [GRPO vs PPO](https://clankur.github.io/doomer/grpo-vs-ppo.html) | GRPO fails on ViZDoom: 1/27 configs learned vs PPO's 6/6 |
